nodes.description: Correct an existing prompt's `branded` tag. This changes the tag and nothing else: the prompt keeps its text, its country, its paused state, its schedule and its whole run history, and no run is triggered, so the metrics already collected for it simply move to the other side of the branded filters. Every prompt created before the tag existed is stored as unbranded whatever its wording, so one that does name the project's own brand has to be corrected here to be returned by `branded: true`. A prompt's text cannot be edited — to reword one, delete it and create a replacement — so this is the only part of a saved prompt that can be changed in place.

specification.text:
schema {
  query: Query
  mutation: Mutation
}

"""
Controls the rate of traffic.
"""
directive @rateLimit(
  """
  Number of seconds before limit is reset.
  """
  duration: Int! = 60
  """
  Number of occurrences allowed over duration.
  """
  limit: Int! = 6
) on FIELD_DEFINITION | OBJECT

type APICallbackHeader {
  key: String!
  value: String!
}

input APICallbackHeaderInput {
  key: String!
  value: String!
}

input AbortBuildInput {
  buildId: ObjectID!
}

type AbortBuildPayload {
  build: Build!
}

input AcceptHealthScoreTestResultsSuggestedThresholdInput {
  healthScoreTestResultIds: [ObjectID!]!
}

type AcceptHealthScoreTestResultsSuggestedThresholdPayload {
  healthScoreTestResults: [HealthScoreTestResult!]!
}

input AcceptSuggestedThresholdInput {
  testResultIds: [ObjectID!]!
}

type AccessibilityIssueSolutionSuggestion {
  createdAt: DateTime!
  id: ObjectID!
  issueDigest: String!
  rawID: String!
  suggestedSolution: String!
  updatedAt: DateTime!
}

type Account {
  accountManagers: [String!]!
  accountSettings: [AccountSetting!]!
  accountSsoClients(
    after: String
    before: String
    """
    Filtering options for AccountSSOClients returned from the connection.
    """
    filter: AccountSSOClientConnectionFilterInput
    first: Int = 15
    last: Int
    """
    Ordering options for AccountSSOClients returned from the connection.
    """
    orderBy: [AccountSSOClientOrder!]
  ): AccountSSOClientConnection
  accountUsers(
    after: String
    before: String
    """
    Filtering options for AccountUsers returned from the connection.
    """
    filter: AccountUserConnectionFilterInput
    first: Int = 15
    last: Int
  ): AccountUserConnection
  active: Boolean!
  addressCity: String
  addressZip: String
  aiFeaturesEnabled: Boolean!
  """
  Number of active (non-paused) AI Visibility prompts across all of the account's projects: what `aiVisibilityPromptsLimit` is enforced against.
  """
  aiVisibilityActivePromptsCount: Int!
  """
  Whether this free-scan account can start its one-time seven-day conversion trial. Checkout rechecks eligibility.
  """
  aiVisibilityConversionTrialEligible: Boolean!
  """
  Whether this account originated from a free AI Visibility scan. Its verified owner can read that report without a subscription.
  """
  aiVisibilityFreeScan: Boolean!
  """
  Maximum number of active AI Visibility prompts a new project on this account could hold, for the schedule cadence it would be created with: the same number `AiVisibilityProject.effectivePromptsLimit` reports, for a project that does not exist yet. It is the lower of the account's prompts-per-project limit, the limit derived from its prompt runs limit, enabled AI provider addons and the cadence, and — when the account has an account-wide limit (`aiVisibilityPromptsLimit`) — the budget its existing projects have left unused. Read it when sizing project setup, so topic and prompt generation asks for a number the project can actually keep. Null when no limit is configured, 0 when provider addons are missing or the account budget is already used up.
  """
  aiVisibilityNewProjectPromptsLimit(
    """
    Schedule cadence the new project would be created with. Defaults to the creation default.
    """
    scheduleCadence: AiVisibilityScheduleCadence! = Daily
  ): Int
  """
  Number of AI Visibility projects on the account: what `aiVisibilityProjectsLimit` is enforced against. Deleted projects are excluded; 0 before the account's first project is created.
  """
  aiVisibilityProjectsCount: Int!
  """
  Maximum number of AI Visibility projects the account may hold, from its `ai_visibility_projects` setting: the limit `createAiVisibilityProject` enforces against `aiVisibilityProjectsCount`. Gate a "create project" action on `aiVisibilityProjectsLimit == null || aiVisibilityProjectsCount < aiVisibilityProjectsLimit` rather than on the setting, so the client and the mutation cannot disagree. Null when the account has no projects limit, which the mutation treats as unlimited — comparing a null limit numerically would disable creation on exactly the accounts that have no cap.
  """
  aiVisibilityProjectsLimit: Int
  """
  Maximum number of active (non-paused) AI Visibility prompts allowed across all of the account's projects combined, from the account's `ai_visibility_prompts` setting. Self-serve plans sell one prompt budget shared by every project, so `aiVisibilityPromptsLimit - aiVisibilityActivePromptsCount` is how many prompts can still be added anywhere on the account, on top of each project's own `effectivePromptsLimit`. Null when the account has no account-wide limit and only the per-project limit applies.
  """
  aiVisibilityPromptsLimit: Int
  apiCallbackHeaders: [APICallbackHeader!]
  apiCallbackUrl: String
  availableAiVisibilityCredits: Float!
  availableCredits(creditAllocationType: CreditAllocationType): Float!
  availableGlobalCustomMetricContainers(
    after: String
    before: String
    """
    Filtering options for CustomMetricContainers returned from the connection.
    """
    filter: CustomMetricContainerConnectionFilterInput
    first: Int = 15
    last: Int
    """
    Ordering options for CustomMetricContainers returned from the connection.
    """
    orderBy: [CustomMetricContainerOrder!]
  ): CustomMetricContainerConnection!
  buildSchedules(
    after: String
    before: String
    """
    Filtering options for BuildSchedules returned from the connection.
    """
    filter: BuildScheduleConnectionFilterInput
    first: Int = 15
    last: Int
    """
    Ordering options for BuildSchedules returned from the connection.
    """
    orderBy: [BuildScheduleOrder!]
  ): BuildScheduleConnection!
  contractStartDate: DateTime
  contractTerminationDate: DateTime
  country: String
  crawlRetentionMonths: Int!
  crawlerIpAddresses: [String!]!
  createdAt: DateTime!
  creditAllocations(
    after: String
    before: String
    """
    Filtering options for CreditAllocations returned from the connection.
    """
    filter: CreditAllocationConnectionFilterInput
    first: Int = 15
    last: Int
    """
    Ordering options for CreditAllocations returned from the connection.
    """
    orderBy: [CreditAllocationOrder!]
  ): CreditAllocationConnection
  creditReportExports(
    after: String
    before: String
    """
    Filtering options for CreditReportExports returned from the connection.
    """
    filter: CreditReportExportConnectionFilterInput
    first: Int = 15
    last: Int
    """
    Ordering options for CreditReportExports returned from the connection.
    """
    orderBy: [CreditReportExportOrder!]
  ): CreditReportExportConnection
  creditReports(
    after: String
    before: String
    """
    Filtering options for CreditReports returned from the connection.
    """
    filter: CreditReportConnectionFilterInput
    first: Int = 15
    last: Int
    """
    Ordering options for CreditReports returned from the connection.
    """
    orderBy: [CreditReportOrder!]
  ): CreditReportConnection
  customDashboardCollections(
    after: String
    before: String
    """
    Filtering options for CustomDashboardCollections returned from the connection.
    """
    filter: CustomDashboardCollectionConnectionFilterInput
    first: Int = 15
    last: Int
    """
    Ordering options for CustomDashboardCollections returned from the connection.
    """
    orderBy: [CustomDashboardCollectionOrder!]
  ): CustomDashboardCollectionConnection!
  customDashboardCollectionsViewCount: Int!
  customDashboardViews(
    after: String
    before: String
    """
    Filtering options for CustomDashboardViews returned from the connection.
    """
    filter: CustomDashboardViewConnectionFilterInput
    first: Int = 15
    last: Int
    """
    Ordering options for CustomDashboardViews returned from the connection.
    """
    orderBy: [CustomDashboardViewOrder!]
  ): CustomDashboardViewConnection
  customDashboards(
    after: String
    before: String
    """
    Filtering options for CustomDashboards returned from the connection.
    """
    filter: CustomDashboardConnectionFilterInput
    first: Int = 15
    last: Int
    """
    Ordering options for CustomDashboards returned from the connection.
    """
    orderBy: [CustomDashboardOrder!]
  ): CustomDashboardConnection!
  customHeaderColor: String
  customLogo: String
  customMenuColor: String
  customMetricContainerGenerations(
    after: String
    before: String
    """
    Filtering options for CustomMetricContainerGenerations returned from the connection.
    """
    filter: CustomMetricContainerGenerationConnectionFilterInput
    first: Int = 15
    last: Int
    """
    Ordering options for CustomMetricContainerGenerations returned from the connection.
    """
    orderBy: [CustomMetricContainerGenerationOrder!]
  ): CustomMetricContainerGenerationConnection!
  customMetricContainers(
    after: String
    before: String
    """

    """
    filter: CustomMetricContainerConnectionFilterInput
    first: Int = 15
    last: Int

  customViews(

    """

    """
    filter: CustomViewConnectionFilterInput
    first: Int = 15
    last: Int
    """
    Ordering options for CustomViews returned from the connection.
    """
    orderBy: [CustomViewOrder!]
  ): CustomViewConnection
  disableUpselling: Boolean!
  featureFlag(flagName: String!): FeatureFlag
  featureFlags: [FeatureFlag!]!
  id: ObjectID!
  jiraAuthentications(after: String, before: String, first: Int = 15, last: Int): JiraAuthenticationConnection!
  legacyTasks(
    after: String
    before: String
    """
    Filtering options for LegacyTasks returned from the connection.
    """
    filter: LegacyTaskConnectionFilterInput
    first: Int = 15
    last: Int
    """
    Ordering options for LegacyTasks returned from the connection.
    """
    orderBy: [LegacyTaskOrder!]
  ): LegacyTaskConnection!
  limitLevelsMax: Int!
  limitPagesMax: Int!

    after: String
    before: String
    """

    """
    filter: LogManagerConnectionConnectionFilterInput
    first: Int = 15
    last: Int
    """

    """
    orderBy: [LogManagerConnectionOrder!]

  maxActiveLegacyTasksPerProject: Int!
  """

  """
  maxCrawlRate: Int!
  maxCrawlsPerProject: Int!
  maxCustomReportsPerProject: Int!

  """

  """

  """

  maxSearchQueriesLimitPerProperty: Int!
  """
  Maximum total of restricted filter predicates allowed in a Segment filter: arrayContainsLike, arrayNotContainsLike, endsWith, contains, notContains, matchesRegex, notMatchesRegex.

  """
  Maximum number of IP allowlist ranges per service account owned by this Account.
  """

"""
What a proposed subscription change would cost and when it would land, priced by the payment provider rather than estimated. Nothing is created or charged by asking.
"""
type PreviewSelfServeAccountSubscriptionChangePayload {
  """
  What the next invoice comes to, tax included. For a change that applies now it is that invoice net of any credit balance on the customer, as Stripe would apply it. For a deferred change it is what its boundary will bill, net of that balance as it stands today: the recurring amount the subscription holds by then, plus anything one-off already waiting on that invoice - proration an earlier change left pending is billed whatever else changes. Null in the two cases that cannot be priced before the change exists: a `Split` change, whose immediate and deferred parts settle on one invoice in a combination the payment provider will only price once the immediate part exists; and an `Immediate` change made while another change is already scheduled, which discards that schedule and prorates, proration that likewise exists only once the change is made. `recurringTotal` is exact in both.
  """
  amountDue: SelfServePlanPrice
  """
  The state the subscription reaches straight away, or null when the whole change is deferred. On a paying subscription an upgrade or an add-on addition lands here, while a downgrade, an add-on removal and an interval change do not. A trial reverses that: a plan-only change waits for the trial to end, however it is priced, and any add-on change at all - adding or removing - converts the subscription to paying there and then, applying the whole requested state with it.
  """
  appliesNow: SelfServeSubscriptionChangeState
  """
  Whether confirming would discard a change already scheduled against the subscription, leaving nothing in its place. An upgrade calls a pending change off outright, and a change made alongside one rewrites it, so a customer can lose a downgrade they had scheduled without `effect` alone saying so. Read `selfServeAccountSubscription.scheduledChange` to show them what they would be giving up.
  """
  cancelsScheduledChange: Boolean!
  """
  When that invoice is raised. Note that an immediate change is not billed at the moment it is made: its proration rides the next invoice, so this is usually the end of the current period rather than today. Ending a trial is the exception and is invoiced on the spot.
  """
  chargedAt: DateTime!
  """
  Which parts of the change land when, as one value to branch on.
  """
  effect: SelfServeSubscriptionChangeEffect!
  """
  What the subscription bills per interval once the whole change has landed, tax included.
  """
  recurringTotal: SelfServePlanPrice!
  """
  The state the subscription reaches at a later boundary, or null when nothing is deferred.
  """
  scheduledChange: SelfServeSubscriptionScheduledChangePreview
}
